text:
Evan: Hey team — starting bring-up for Rainbird-7b on 8xA100. Need quick perf scan: steady-state throughput, p50/p95 token latency at seq=512, peak memory, and a smoke correctness check. Who can take this? Thanks.

Katie: I can run smoke + latency sweep today. Any preferred prompts?

Evan: thx. Use the standard smoke prompt set: https://redwood.internal/smoke-sets/rainbird-7b (private). Focus on topline latency and generation correctness.

Jorge: I'll kick the throughput sweep. Which server pool? 8xA100-80GB v2?

Evan: yes, 8xA100-80GB-v2, model tag rb7b-v1. Run with quant: int8 and float16.

Jorge: running now. cmd:
```
benchrun --model rb7b-v1 --pool a100-8x --seq 512 --threads 4 --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --quant {fp16,int8} --out /tmp/rainbird-scan.json
```

bench-bot: Job 4441234568 started by Jorge. ETA ~12m.

bench-bot: Job 4441234580 completed. Summary attached.

bench-bot: Results (avg over 3 runs):
- fp16 batch1: throughput 120 toks/sec, p50 85ms, p95 210ms, GPU mem 42GB
- fp16 batch8: throughput 720 toks/sec, p50 95ms, p95 260ms, GPU mem 58GB
- int8 batch1: throughput 160 toks/sec, p50 65ms, p95 150ms, GPU mem 34GB
- int8 batch8: throughput 980 toks/sec, p50 80ms, p95 190ms, GPU mem 50GB

Maya: int8 looks promising, p95 still OK. Any generation regressions?

Katie: smoke run pass, small truncation on prompt 7 with int8—looks like tokenization edge-case. I'll add an eval ticket.

Evan: awesome. Action items:
- Jorge: push plots + raw json to s3: s3://redwood/rainbird/4441234567/
- Katie: file eval ticket w/ sample and label
- Maya: add to rollout canary doc

Sam: flagged infra alert — need to limit background jobs on that pool during canary. :warning:

Evan: noted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
